Class V1beta2DeviceTaintRule

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.kubernetes.client.openapi.model.V1beta2DeviceTaintRule
All Implemented Interfaces:
KubernetesObject, KubernetesType
@Generated("io.micronaut.openapi.generator.JavaMicronautClientCodegen") public class V1beta2DeviceTaintRule extends Object implements KubernetesObject
DeviceTaintRule adds one taint to all devices which match the selector. This has the same effect as if the taint was specified directly in the ResourceSlice by the DRA driver.
